disagreements.their_reason: A fitted artifact changing during this update run would falsify update-only learning; fingerprints from a separate append experiment do not rule that out.
Equivalent transferred performance at matched refusal would falsify non-transferability; no matched-operating-point comparison was performed.
A better head at two aliases reaching 1-NN, or a persistent asymptotic gap, would falsify the causal explanation; a finite grid and shrinking finite curve rule out neither.
A population with a head gap above 0.05 would falsify the stated universal criterion; the supplied evidence reports only one population.
Equalized successful rewrites showing no edge benefit would falsify the two-operation explanation; the conditions differ substantially in edited and ambiguous cases, so edge supply is not isolated.
